title: 2,6-Dioxabicyclo[3.3.1]nonan-3-ones: from natural product treasure troves to synthetic triumphs
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,9118-9142
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07728A, Review Article
Open Access

Utkal Mani Choudhury, Pragna Pratic Das, Debendra Kumar Mohapatra
This review presents an overview of their natural occurrence alongside a critical analysis of synthetic methodologies and serve as a comprehensive resource for researchers exploring the chemistry of 2,6-disubstituted THP-based bicyclic lactones.
